info.title: DD Monitor API
info.description:
Backend of the DD regulatory monitoring platform (steps 0 to 10).

Flow: Upload, poll Progress every 1 to 2 seconds until the run is finished, Draft, Confirm
(embedding and cleanup then run in the background; Progress shows the project state),
Profile, Update, Audit. Ids are opaque strings. No authentication (single user).

Every error has the shape `{code, message, details, error_id}`. Codes:
`validation`, `bad_request`, `empty_upload`, `upload_too_large`, `not_found`, `wrong_state`, `stale_draft`, `stale_profile`, `busy`, `run_active`, `publish_failed`, `not_supported`, `database_unavailable`, `method_not_allowed`, `internal_error`.

post.summary: Upload a data room and start the run
post.description:
Stores every file below a new company folder (relative paths kept), creates the
company id and starts the run in the background. Unsupported file types are accepted and
reported later as unsupported; unsafe paths, duplicates and files over a limit are
rejected one by one with a reason. Poll Progress every 1 to 2 seconds.

post.summary: Process the stored files again (before confirmation only)

get.summary: Project state, latest run and one record per document
The profile draft for review, with sources and evidence quotes
get.description:
Fields with status, candidate groups with sources and evidence quotes (untrusted
document text: render as plain text), needs-review flags, non-binding suggestions, list
rows, the draft version, the open decisions and the open hints. Only in state
published after a finished run.

post.summary: Confirm the profile with the advisor's decisions
post.description:
All or nothing. Every open decision of the Draft call needs one decision (nothing
is pre-selected). Problems come back per field (code validation); a newer draft answers
stale_draft. On success embedding and cleanup start in the background.

get.summary: The confirmed profile with citations and its version
get.description:
Values with their citation (file and page in `fundstelle`, the cited document in
`quelle`; advisor-entered values say so instead), the profile version needed by Update,
the "embeddings stale" flag and the audit log. Never evidence quotes or conflict
alternatives.

post.summary: Update entries of a confirmed profile
post.description:
All or nothing; there is no undo (ask "are you sure" first). Refused before
confirmation (wrong_state), while confirm, embedding or cleanup runs (busy) and on a
stale profile version (stale_profile); invalid values come back per field. The vectors
are refreshed in the background; Progress shows "embeddings stale" until then.

get.description:
Confirmations, profile changes (field, old and new value, reason), sent emails and
template edits: what and when.

AppliedDecision.title: AppliedDecision
AppliedDecision.description: An advisor decision applied to a draft field; set only on the confirmed draft.

AuditEntry.title: AuditEntry
AuditEntry.description: A row of `pipeline.audit_log`. `id` and `acted_at` are set by the database.

files.title: Files
files.description: every file of the DD folder (repeat the field once per file)

paths.title: Paths
paths.description: relative path of each file, same order as `files` (for example 'Steuern/Bescheide/KSt 2022.pdf'); without it the file name of each part is used

project_name.title: Project Name
project_name.description: optional project name; the company id is made from it

Candidate.title: Candidate
Candidate.description: One value for one field from one document: a row of `field_candidates`.

CandidateGroup.title: CandidateGroup
CandidateGroup.description:
Candidates that count as the same value. `value` is the most precise member
(for list items: the most complete one, gaps filled from the other members).

CellChoice.title: CellChoice
CellChoice.description: One cell of a list row: take it from a candidate group, or type it. Exactly one.

ConfirmBody.title: ConfirmBody
ConfirmBody.description: The advisor's final choice per open decision (see the Draft call).

ConfirmedProfile.title: ConfirmedProfile
ConfirmedProfile.description: Read side after confirmation: values, citations, version and the audit log.

Decision.title: Decision
Decision.description: The advisor's choice for one scalar field or one list row.

DecisionAction.title: DecisionAction
DecisionAction.description: What the advisor decided for one field or list row (step 8).

DocumentCitation.title: DocumentCitation
DocumentCitation.description: The `dokument` row a value cites: the advisor re-checks it in their own copy.

HintRow.title: HintRow
HintRow.description: An open `pruefhinweis` row of the company (profil schema).

OpenDecision.title: OpenDecision
OpenDecision.description: Something the advisor must decide before the profile can be confirmed.

ProfileRow.title: ProfileRow
ProfileRow.description: A row of the confirmed profile with its citation (never an evidence quote).

ProjectState.title: ProjectState
ProjectState.description: Moves forward one step at a time; a failed step leaves it unchanged.

ReviewView.title: ReviewView
ReviewView.description: Everything the review screen reads; no extraction happens here.

UpdateBody.title: UpdateBody
UpdateBody.description: Changes to a confirmed profile (edit, add, remove, end).
